## What changed

Describe the behavior and the user or maintainer impact.

## Evidence

List the exact commands, fixtures, and outputs used to validate the change.

## Safety

- [ ] I added or updated regression tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not weaken type checking, coverage, security, or release gates.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no real credentials, personal data, or private source.
- [ ] The commit author and committer use my own GitHub identity.
